table_description: Live Docker services and containers observed on platform hosts. Populated from state snapshots and infra-agent docker_state queries.
use_cases: Check what's actually running on a host
Compare actual image versions against desired state
Identify containers that have been running longest
data_quality_notes: replicas is TEXT (e.g., '1/1') — split on '/' to compare desired vs actual
image_tag may be 'latest' which hides the actual version
Host partitions refresh independently; join on host plus service_name and use per-host MAX(observed_at). Expose stale or unobserved partitions.
Swarm task labels establish service identity and host placement; one row per service/host, not per task. Manager-only records without observed placement are cluster observations.
state includes running, degraded, stopped and unknown. Positive equal replicas mean available, 0/0 means intentionally stopped; availability does not prove application health.
